fichas.title: Self-Service Shops and Supermarket
fichas.summary: Self-service shops mainly sell food. Staff provide advice, assistance, and service, while butchery, cold meats, fruit, and vegetable sections are staffed. Goods are displayed in clearly organized packaging. The customer route begins at the basket stack or trolley park and ends at the checkout or packing table. The illustrated supermarket plan organizes food and non-food departments around the shopping route and checkout.
